title: FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Short-interval wireless schedulers must return a complete, feasible beam-and-resource allocation before each execution deadline, and a late or invalid output gives no utility in the current control cycle. Searching longer can increase transmitted traffic, but it may also miss the deadline or leave only an infeasible intermediate solution. We propose Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement (FPTR), which always keeps a validated feasible allocation, the incumbent. Each refinement stage builds a separate candidate and leaves the incumbent unchanged. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is complete, passes the feasibility validator before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective; otherwise it is discarded. Four refinement stages use this rule: buffer-aware resource selection, compatibility-group (CG) user sharing, beam-mask rebuilding from remaining demand, and joint reassignment of two resources. On 150 fixed s

translated_title: FPTR：面向截止期受限的联合波束与资源分配的可行性保持事务式精化算法
translated_abstract: 短间隔无线调度器必须在每个执行截止期之前返回完整、可行的波束与资源分配方案，而迟到或无效的输出在当前控制周期内不产生任何效用。延长搜索时间虽然可以增加传输流量，但也可能错过截止期，或仅留下一个不可行的中间解。我们提出了可行性保持事务式精化算法，它始终保留一个经过验证的可行分配方案（即当前最优解）。每个精化阶段都会构建一个独立的候选解，而不改变当前最优解。只有当候选解是完整的、在其阶段截止时间之前通过可行性验证器验证，并且严格改进目标函数时，它才会替换当前最优解；否则该候选解将被丢弃。四个精化阶段采用这一规则：基于缓冲区的资源选择、兼容组（CG）用户共享、基于剩余需求的波束掩码重建，以及两个资源的联合重新分配。在150个固定的（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出FPTR算法，通过“候选解必须完整、在阶段截止前通过可行性验证且严格改进目标才能替换当前最优解”的事务式机制，确保无线调度器在截止期约束下始终输出有效可行的波束与资源分配方案。
en_tdlr: FPTR is a transactional refinement algorithm that always preserves a validated feasible beam-and-resource allocation as the incumbent, replacing it only when a candidate is complete, passes feasibility validation before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective, thereby guaranteeing valid outputs under deadline constraints.
